{{Cat main|Conspiracy theory}}
{{Cat see also|Urban legends}}
Articles relating to [[Conspiracy theory|conspiracy theories]], explanations for events or situations that invoke a [[conspiracy]] by sinister and powerful groups, often political in motivation, when [[Occam's razor|other explanations are more probable]]. The term has a negative connotation, implying that the appeal to a conspiracy is based on prejudice or insufficient evidence.
